products.details_excerpt:
Product Description
Joining the PROPLICA series from the anime "ONE PIECE" comes Roronoa Zoro's "Wado Ichimonji", "Saindai Kitetsu", and "Enma"! In order to truly allow users to experience the source material, the "Wado Ichimonji", "Saindai Kitetsu", and "Enma" have been made on a 1/1 scale using an official 3D model!
The "Wado Ichimonji" also comes with an exchangeable part to allow users to more easily wield it in one's mouth and re-enact Roronoa Zoro's "Three Sword Style"! "Enma" also contains an audio gimmick that includes lines from ZORO as well as BGM tracks!

zoro_reference_only_products.name: Nerf Netflix One Piece Zoro's Katana (Wado Ichimonji) Sword with Foam Blade
zoro_reference_only_products.description: Kids can imagine themselves as a Straw Hat Pirate with the One Piece Nerf Katana inspired by Zoro's katana from the Netflix One Piece series! The Zoro's Katana (Wado Ichimonji) captures the look of the katana wielded by Roronoa Zoro in the live-action series based on the popular One Piece manga. This Nerf katana measures 24 inches long (609 millimeters) and has a foam blade with a plastic core and foam hilt. In the series, Zoro is a master swordsman, ex-bounty hunter, and one of the Straw Hat Pirates who go on an epic voyage to find the legendary One Piece treasure. The assortment includes 3 different katanas (each sold separately, subject to availability), and are perfect accessories for role play, cosplay, and every swashbuckling adventure. Ages 6 and up.
zoro_reference_only_products.reason_not_selected: Netflix 24-inch foam roleplay toy, not a full-size anime replica; merchant not accepting new affiliates
